title: Nucleus-Image: Sparse MoE Diffusion Transformer
summary: The first high-quality Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) diffusion transformer for image generation, utilizing 17B total parameters with only ~2B active per forward pass. It achieves high efficiency while matching or exceeding dense models like FLUX.1 and SD3.5 in spatial layout and prompt adherence.
research_notes: Open-sourced under Apache-2.0 license; features technical innovations like Text KV Caching and Decoupled Routing to stabilize MoE training.

evolution.summary: Following its April 2026 release as a raw pre-trained base model, the project focuses on post-training optimizations including DPO/RLHF and community-led quantization efforts to handle the 17B parameter footprint on consumer GPUs.
